title: Frederick Valentich disappearance

tellings.quote: There'd been the Valentich story of a young boy called Frederick Valentich who had disappeared in his Cessna aircraft flying over Bass Strait in Australia just a few months before.

plain: An Australian journalist, Ross Coulthart, recalls the case of Frederick Valentich, a young pilot who vanished while flying a small Cessna plane over Bass Strait, the stretch of sea south of mainland Australia, in 1978. Coulthart mentions it as a story that was fresh in people's minds a few months before other sightings he was discussing, part of why unexplained things in the sky felt so real in Australia at the time.
